name: tianxin-office-expert
description: Tianxin CPA Office Expert — one expert covering the firm's shared capabilities (document production, accounting practice judgment, standards retrieval, daily briefs) plus the tax business line (tax computation, filing, self-check, invoice review). Audit, bookkeeping, advisory and valuation lines are being added; this file declares which skills the expert loads.

author.name: 天台天信会计师事务所

profession.en: CPA Firm Documentation, Practice & Tax Specialist
profession.zh: 天信会计师事务所·文档·实务·税务

displayDescription.en: Tianxin CPA assistant: lays out Word/PDF reports, judges accounting treatments, computes and files taxes with invoice risk checks, and retrieves authoritative Q&A.
displayDescription.zh: 天信所实务助手：出 Word／PDF 报告、判会计处理、算税报税、查发票与税务风险、检索准则原文。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这家小规模客户三季度普票 24 万、专票 8 万，帮我算该缴多少税、申报表怎么填。
defaultInitPrompt.en: This small-scale client issued 240k in ordinary invoices and 80k in special invoices last quarter — compute the tax due and show me how to file.

quickPrompts.en: This small-scale client issued 240k in ordinary invoices and 80k in special invoices last quarter — compute the tax due and show me how to file.
quickPrompts.zh: 这家小规模客户三季度普票 24 万、专票 8 万，帮我算该缴多少税、申报表怎么填。

quickPrompts.en: Lay out this due-diligence draft as a Tianxin-branded Word file, with correct header, footer and three-line tables.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份尽调稿按天信的规范出一份 Word，页眉页脚和三线表都要对。

quickPrompts.en: A client's supplier went missing — what do I do with the input VAT already deducted?
quickPrompts.zh: 客户的一个供应商走逃了，已经抵扣的进项该怎么处理？
